sources.entry: Knovum - Local-first 2D spatial AI knowledge space with embedded LanceDB vector search, infinite canvas, and on-device Whisper transcription. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/madebyzan/knovum) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Knovum is a free, open-source, local-first desktop knowledge workspace (Tauri 2 and Rust) that combines an infinite canvas, cited AI answers over your own sources, local semantic search, and on-device AI tools.
summary.what_it_does: Knovum lets you place notes, saved web pages and videos, meeting recordings, PDFs, Office documents, images and code on one infinite canvas called a Space. Recordings are transcribed locally with timestamps and speakers, and OCR, embeddings and semantic search run on-device. You can ask questions and get answers whose citations point to a specific passage, timestamp or PDF page, with citations marked current or detached as sources change. Selected material can be turned into a generated document, image, video or voice track, with the engine, model and inputs recorded. The README also describes structured knowledge objects (Concept, Question, Claim, Evidence, Experiment, Decision) linked by typed relations, plus export to DOCX, PDF, PPTX, HTML and Markdown.
use_cases: searching PDFs and notes by meaning
clipping web pages and videos into a canvas
offline knowledge base on a Mac or Windows PC
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (as given in the README)
notable: Citations keep their location (timestamp, PDF page, heading) and stay tied to the revision they quoted; a changed source marks them detached.
Generated results record their engine, model, inputs and input revisions, so each output can show where it came from.
On-device AI models are downloaded on first use and verified against pinned SHA-256 digests.
Runs a Builtin Agent and exposes the Space to desktop agents through a loopback-only MCP server.
Supports JSON Canvas (.canvas) import and export and a portable .knovumspace package format.
caveats: Desktop only: macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10 version 2004+ x64; Linux and Windows on ARM are not supported yet.
Builds are not yet notarized by Apple or Authenticode-signed, so the first launch needs manual confirmation.
Answers and generation need a connected AI provider or desktop agent; cloud models are optional and bring-your-own-key.
